concepts.name: Connecting the Dots…
concepts.definition: Central learning focus of Connecting the Dots….
concepts.source_evidence: 5 CONNECTING THE DOTS… 5.1 Of Questions and Statements Your teacher tells you that they are meeting two of their childhood friends this evening.

concepts.name: Evidence and reasoning
concepts.definition: Use source information, observation or valid working to support a conclusion.
concepts.source_evidence: What is your guess as to each friend’s gender based on this information?

concepts.name: Application and transfer
concepts.definition: Use the learned idea in a relevant new context.
concepts.source_evidence: You might have guessed that the 5-foot-tall person is a woman and the 6-foot-tall person is a man.
